name: atmosphere_contents
summary: What gas or liquid one thing holds: a canister, tank, suit, pipe network, landing pad network, a device's networks and the canisters in its slots, or an atmosphere_id. With a water summary. Read only.

help.text: Each atmosphere has a source and lists every gas and liquid with amount_mol (and liquid_l for liquids), plus volume_l, pressure_kpa, temperature_k, total_mol and a water summary. Owners have kind item, structure, dynamic (a portable tank) or pipe_network.

sources.text: internal: the thing's own atmosphere. pipe_network: a pipe's whole network, or a network named by its id. landing_pad_network: any landing pad piece, the pad network's one shared atmosphere. mounted_pipe_network: a device mounted on a pipe (a Pipe Analyzer, a gauge), the network of the pipe it sits on, as the game reads it. connected_network: every pipe network a device is connected to. slot: the canisters in its slots (a tank storage, an air conditioner).

water.text: liquid water (liquid_mol, liquid_l, and the hydration drinking it gives: 5 per litre, 55.56 mol per litre), polluted water (polluted_mol, polluted_l) and steam (steam_mol, steam_if_condensed_l). liquid_l comes from each liquid's molar volume. Polluted water needs a water purifier first, and steam must condense before it can be drunk.

refusals.text: no_atmosphere: the thing has no internal atmosphere, is not a pipe or landing pad piece, joins no pipe network, and holds nothing with an atmosphere. thing_not_found: nothing has that id; room and world air cannot be read this way (rooms reads room air).

reference_id.description: A thing, a pipe or landing pad network, or an atmosphere_id (water_sources).
